scope: Quenched SU(3) lattice gauge theory with Wilson quarks at one coupling: static potential, pion, rho and nucleon masses at four quark masses, chiral limit, and the Polyakov-loop correlator below and above the deconfinement transition. Quark loops are dropped. Masses are in lattice units and in units of the string tension of the same lattice. No mass in GeV is derived.
